description: This file is a shell script used for testing various Git commands outside of a repository, including setup procedures and verification of command behaviors outside repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success based on the description and command execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes provided lines to a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern in output or file, confirming presence.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that the command exits with expected code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a set of tests.
